Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PRESSURE PINS 



o 

CD 

1 

a 



1. Scope 

1.1 Specifies dimensions and requirements for pressure pins used in press working tools for ejecting 
the pressed part from the top tool or bottom tcol actuated by air cylinder, spring, rubber or any 
mechanical device. 

1.2 For preferred hole size in bolster plates for pressure pin holes, see Appendix A. 

2. Types — The pressure pins shall be of the following three types: 

Type A Plain 

Type B Threaded end 

Type C Collared end 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Material and Hardness 

4.1 Un hardened Pressure Pins — Medium carbon steel having hardness of 175 BHN, Mln. 

4.2 Hardended Pressure Pins — Suitable core hardened steel to give hardness of 52 HRC. Min. 

5. Designation 

5.1 A pressure pin unhardened Type A having diameter d = 32 mm and / = 300 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Pressure Pin A 32 x 300 IS : 10650 

5.2 A pressure pin, hardened, Type B having diameter d = 25 mm, and /=300 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Pressure Pjn B 25 x 300 H IS : 10650 

6. Finish — The pressure pins shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. 

7. Preservation and Packing 

7.1 A suitable anticorrosive treatment shall be given to pressure pins. 

7.2 Pressure pins shall be packed in accordance with the best trade practice. 

8. Marking — Jhe pressure pins shall be marked at an appropriate place with the diameter d, 
length / and tfayrnanuf acturer's name or trade-mark. 

iM ; /5/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been prepared based upon experience of the Indian industry with a view to 
rationalize the types and sizes of pressure pins.
